description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the behavior of the actual trained NextItNet model and generates an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions.
motivation: Support model improvement using reproducible diagnostics while preserving the NextItNet backbone, benchmark protocol, available-data constraints, and one independently trained model per category.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Preserve ModelView compatibility through view.model, item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Adapt probes to NextItNet’s causal convolutional representations and use the final nonpadding position for left-padded histories. Report only measurements supported by public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; treat unavailable review fields and simulator traits as unobserved. Keep checkpoints and generated predictors consistent. Route four categories to their respective single models. Use the host’s macro-average validation HR@10 for selection; diagnostics do not replace that evaluator.
pseudocode:
Initialize DiagnosisProbe(view, device)
For each diagnostic batch:
    Unpack (_, sequence, positive, negative)
    Compute NextItNet features through view.log2feats(sequence)
    Exclude padding from applicable measurements
    Use the final nonpadding position when a sequence-level feature is needed
    Compute supported diagnostics through the actual model and compatibility interfaces
Aggregate measurements with explicit definitions and valid-sample counts
Return {metrics, metric_definitions}
Build diagnosis_interpreter_prompt from returned measurements and definitions
Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five real training users per category
Select model changes using the host's four-category macro validation HR@10

originality.positive: Connects architecture-aware diagnostics with explicit data provenance and a fixed evaluation contract.
originality.negative: The supplied description specifies an integration interface rather than a novel diagnostic algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Can support systematic diagnosis and targeted improvements as the single NextItNet architecture evolves.
future_potential.negative: Its usefulness depends on choosing reliable diagnostic measurements; the description does not specify concrete metrics or demonstrate predictive value.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and batch structure provide clear implementation boundaries.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding handling, architecture-specific probes, missing-data handling, and checkpoint/predictor consistency require careful integration.
